Preregistered: Parametric sex effect plus cyclic sex-specific time smooth
Analysed: Parametric Female level plus cyclic Female-minus-Male deviation; common daily curve retained
Consequence: The joint null covers both a time-constant level and a time-varying shape difference.

Preregistered: Site factor smooth, site random effect, and participant random-effect smooth
Analysed: Inherited sum-to-zero site temporal deviations, participant-specific time curves, and participant-day random intercept; no site random intercept
Consequence: Inference is conditional on these observed sites and the richer repeated-measure structure.

Preregistered: No photoperiod-state or activity-adjusted causal estimand
Analysed: No photoperiod-state term or activity adjustment in the retained test; an exploratory same-sample activity-context adjustment was added
Consequence: Sample restriction and observational adjustment are shown separately; no behavioural, causal, or mediational interpretation is made.

Preregistered: Delta AIC of at least 2; AR(1) if needed; FDR if multiple tests
Analysed: Participant-cluster robust global curve test; separate two-test BH level/shape decomposition
Consequence: The confirmatory claim is the complete curve, not a selected pointwise interval or raw component p-value.

Analysed: Female-to-Male shifted ratios and robust fitted-curve variation, reported only after a supported global result
Consequence: Fitted-curve variation is not described as variance explained.
